# DB migration
Migrations are irreversible on this cluster. Follow these steps exactly in order: 1) snapshot 2) dry-run against replica 3) verify row counts 4) apply 5) verify. Do not reorder or skip; a missed snapshot has destroyed data twice (2025-11, 2026-02).
